resources.string: Wait for the signal, then press first. Jump the gun and you are out of the round.
Everyone whacks the same critters at once. Spare the spiky ones.
Everyone plays at once on this screen, each in a zone of their own. Computers fill any empty zone.
Race one to three computers, each in a zone of its own.
People who play at the same time, each in a zone of their own.
Classic: press when GO appears. Colour match: press only on the target shape. Echo: tap the pattern back first.
Wait, then press the moment GO appears. Pressing early puts you out of the round.
Shapes flash past. Press only when the target shape shows: the shape tells it apart, not the colour.
Watch a pattern of four shapes, then be the first to tap it back without a mistake.
How many rounds the duel is played over. The first to win more than half takes it.
For players who find quick presses hard: longer windows and no penalty for pressing early or wrongly.
Echo scans the four pads for you and one press picks the lit one. The other duels already need one button.
Each zone turns to face the player around the device. Switch off to keep every zone upright.
The round ends when the clock runs out. The highest score wins.
Every zone gets the same critters at the same moments, so the race is fair.
More critters at once. On a small screen with three or four players the grid shrinks so every hole stays big enough to tap.
For players who find fast taps hard: slower critters that stay up longer, big 3 x 3 holes, and no penalties.
A cursor sweeps over your holes and one press whacks the hole it is on. Critters stay up much longer.
